title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（西村督研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Nishimura Toku)
educationalGoal: This course aims to theoretically elucidate the conditions under which an external force is applied and a spatial structure collapses against the objective of planning and designing a safe and comfortable building. In addition, we propose a methodology for forming a structural form having the performance (rigidity, proof stress, deformation amount, energy absorption capacity, etc.) required by a structural designer using an optimization technique.
advice:
[Previous term]
Acquisition of basic knowledge / Project setting / Project execution
1)Learn basic knowledge about each activity area.
2)Receive guidance on each project theme through a report at the general report seminar and complete the project proposal.
3)Conduct experiments, analysis and design according to your project proposal.
[Latter term]
Project Implementation / Summary of Project Outcomes
4)Perform experiments, analysis and design according to your project proposal.
5)The results so far will be announced at the interim presentation on structural engineering.
6)Summarize the results of the activities performed (experiment, analysis, design).
7)Summarize the results of the entire project and submit it as a project report.
8)The contents of the project report will be announced at the public presentation review committee of Project DesignⅢ.

achievementLevels.ideal: As the project theme, students themselves set themes that have not yet been solved regarding the structural stability problem, themes that have not been specifically addressed with regard to structural optimization, plan the entire project to solve the set theme, necessary research, Experiments and analyzes can be conducted in collaboration with the instructor.
achievementLevels.standard: Under the guidance of our faculty members, you can select a project theme and carry out the entire project plan, necessary surveys, experiments and analysis to solve the selected theme.
